pairs.left: The Queen’s Croquet-Ground ¶49 to The Queen’s Croquet-Ground ¶51: “How do you like the Queen?” said the Cat in a low voice. “Not at all,” said Alice: “she’s so extremely—” Just then she noticed that the Queen was close behind her, listening: so she went on, “—likely to win, that it’s hardly worth while finishing the game.” The Queen smiled and passed on.;
